script: echo "=== 主机名/系统 ==="; hostname; uname -a; echo "=== 桥接服务 ==="; systemctl is-active xinmo-bridge 2>/dev/null || echo "未安装/未运行"; echo "=== 网站目录 ==="; ls -ld /var/www/xinmo-site 2>/dev/null && echo "网站存在"; echo "站点文件数: $(find /var/www/xinmo-site -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"; echo "=== Caddy 服务 ==="; systemctl is-active caddy 2>/dev/null || echo "caddy状态未知"; echo "=== 网站首页标题 ==="; grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" /var/www/xinmo-site/index.html 2>/dev/null | head -1
